name: financial-doc-agent
description: Smart Conversational Agent for Financial Document Processing (React+Vite Frontend & Node.js/Express Backend)

scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev: node init && node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: node init && cd backend && npm start
